checks.evidence: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from RBC, steps 1-2: the old MA data is replaced by the new MA from the RBC. Level 2 is not named, and showing the new data is not checked.

Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from a main-signal balise group, steps 1-2: all old MA data is replaced by the new MA. Level 1 is not named, and showing the new data is not checked.

Partial replacement of MA data upon receiving infill information, steps 2-3: data up to the next main signal is unchanged and data beyond it is replaced by the infill MA. The infill data is not explicitly said to start at the balise group at the next main signal, but the behaviour is equivalent.

invented: The precondition in the infill test that MA_old extends beyond the next main signal is not stated in the requirement.
The first assumption, that the OBU is not in a critical failure state, is not stated in the requirement.
